title: 1RB0LC_1LA1RF_1LD0LE_1RE0RA_1LC0RD_0RE---: every separator is a mover the head crosses unchanged, and an exact simulator on that reaches 10^15 steps
text: The separators of the list, the reservoir's words and the separators the reflector has passed are all one particle, a mover, and Lean proves that the head crosses any run of movers unchanged in both directions. So every bounce of a drain or a rebuild is a lemma except the few cells where the head turns. A simulator built on these lemmas, with only the collisions run cell by cell, matches direct simulation at 2.9·10<sup>10</sup> steps and runs to 10<sup>15</sup> without a halt, reproducing the lists of the earlier unproved accelerated run. A halt can now only come from a collision.
